facts.value: You will be required to upload a completed I-983 (pgs. 1-4) when starting a new job or adding an additional job.

metadata.chunk_title: Updates in Employment Information + Multiple employers

facts.value: Changes in employer name, EIN, employer address, working location, hours, compensation, job responsibilities, or training plan/learning objectives require an updated I-983.

metadata.chunk_title: Updates in Employment Information + Multiple employers

facts.value: If your supervisor changes and the new supervisor will continue with the same training plan and your job responsibilities will not change, an updated I-983 is not required.

metadata.chunk_title: Updates in Employment Information + Multiple employers

facts.value: If the change in job title does not impact your main job responsibilities and/or the training plan, an updated I-983 is not required.

metadata.chunk_title: Updates in Employment Information + Multiple employers

facts.value: Students may have multiple jobs while on STEM OPT, provided all conditions of the STEM OPT employment criteria are met.

metadata.chunk_title: Updates in Employment Information + Multiple employers

facts.value: Each job must be related to your major area of study, require at least 20 hours a week, be with a company that participates in E-Verify, and must be a paid position.

facts.value: Updating your records will invalidate your STEM OPT employment authorization, and your I-20 and EAD card will no longer be valid.

metadata.chunk_title: Early Completion of the 24-month STEM OPT and Leaving the U.S., or Change of Status

facts.value: If you change your visa status before your STEM OPT expiration date, submit the Closing F-1 SEVIS Record Request eForm through the ISSC eForm Portal and upload form I-797A Approval Notice or other evidence you have received a new visa status.
